plugin_desc: SNMP child template for Icotera FTTH / GPON / CATV / VoIP CPE devices (i64xx and i68xx families, enterprise PEN 29865). On i6400-series units with a DDM-capable optical transceiver it reads the ICOTERA-I6400-SERIES ictTransceiver scalars (1.3.6.1.4.1.29865.11.3.1.3): transceiver temperature (1/256 degree Celsius), supply voltage (1/10000 V), Tx / Rx optical power (1/10000 mW) and laser bias current (1/500 mA), converted to degrees Celsius, volts, mW and mA. Units without a DDM transceiver, and i68xx units, produce no transceiver series. No device-level CPU, memory, fan or power-supply object is collected. The shared Access SNMP floor supplies MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB/ifXTable interface metrics including 64-bit ifHCInOctets and ifHCOutOctets. Supported brands/models - Icotera i64xx (1K CPE) and i68xx (4K CPE) FTTH/GPON/CATV/VoIP terminal devices that expose standard IF-MIB.
name: Access

metrics.name: transceiver_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of the optical transceiver on Icotera i6400-series CPE in degrees Celsius, from transceiverDdmTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.29865.11.3.1.3.1.0, 1/256 degree units, divided by 256). Absent when no DDM-capable transceiver is fitted.

metrics.name: transceiver_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Supply voltage of the optical transceiver in volts, from transceiverDdmVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.29865.11.3.1.3.4.0, 1/10000 V units, divided by 10000). A raw value of 0 is treated as no transceiver and dropped.

metrics.name: transceiver_tx_power_mw
metrics.description: Transmit optical power of the transceiver in mW, from transceiverDdmTxPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.29865.11.3.1.3.2.0, 1/10000 mW units, divided by 10000).

metrics.name: transceiver_rx_power_mw
metrics.description: Receive optical power of the transceiver in mW, from transceiverDdmRxPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.29865.11.3.1.3.3.0, 1/10000 mW units, divided by 10000). 0 means no light is received.

metrics.name: transceiver_tx_bias_ma
metrics.description: Laser bias current of the transceiver in mA, from transceiverDdmTxBiasCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.29865.11.3.1.3.5.0, 1/500 mA units, divided by 500).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
